title: Pure Malefic
summary: The pure Malefic build with Stardust Dragon and Cyber End Dragon in the Extra Deck as banish fodder, Level 10 and 12 Synchro payoffs, and generic staples. Every Malefic requires a face-up Field Spell to stay on the board, and Malefic Territory lets multiple differently named Malefics coexist and attack.

summary.title: Starters
points: Malefic Paradox Gear Tributes itself while a Field Spell is up to Special Summon Malefic Parallel Gear from the Deck and search any Malefic monster, and can banish itself in place of any Malefic's required counterpart.
Malefic Territory activates Malefic World directly from the Deck and removes the single-Malefic-on-field and single-attacker restrictions.
Malefic Selector banishes two Malefic cards from your GY to search two Malefic cards with different names.

summary.title: Opening: Paradox Gear + Territory
steps: Activate Malefic Territory to place Malefic World from your Deck.
Normal Summon Malefic Paradox Gear and Tribute it to Special Summon Malefic Parallel Gear from the Deck and search Malefic Paradigm Dragon or Malefic Stardust Dragon.
Use Level 2 Parallel Gear and a Level 8 Malefic in your hand to Synchro Summon Level 10 Malefic Paradox Dragon or Bystial Dis Pater.

Banish a Malefic from the Extra Deck to Special Summon Malefic Paradigm Dragon, which returns a banished Level 8 Synchro like Stardust Dragon and pairs with Level 2 Parallel Gear for Crimson Dragon into Cosmic Blazar Dragon.

summary.title: Field Spell Protection & Paradox Gear
summary.text: Normally, each Malefic monster must banish its specific counterpart from the Deck or Extra Deck and blows itself up if there is no face-up Field Spell. Malefic Paradox Gear substitutes for Blue-Eyes White Dragon, Red-Eyes Black Dragon, and Rainbow Dragon so you do not need to run brick Normal Monsters in the Main Deck, while Malefic Stardust Dragon protects your active Field Spell from being destroyed.

summary.title: Bosses & Payoff
points: Malefic Cyber End Dragon, Malefic Rainbow Dragon, and Malefic Paradox Dragon hit the board at 4000 ATK, while Malefic Truth Dragon summons itself for half your LP when a Malefic is destroyed.
Bystial Dis Pater revives a banished LIGHT or DARK monster and shuffles banished cards back to negate or destroy.
Crimson Dragon tags out alongside a Level 12 Synchro to cheat out Cosmic Blazar Dragon, and two Level 8 Malefics make Number 38: Hope Harbinger Dragon Titanic Galaxy.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Malefic Paradigm Shift can be activated from the hand for half your LP: it activates Malefic World and summons a Malefic directly from the Deck or Extra Deck.
Malefic Force equips to a monster to search a Malefic card, and banishes itself from the GY while a Field Spell is active to destroy all monsters on the field.
Malefic Divide revives a Malefic from the GY ignoring its summoning conditions, and Malefic Tune draws 2 cards when a Malefic is destroyed.

allow.Stardust Dragon: Malefic Stardust Dragon banishes it from the Extra Deck to summon itself, and Paradigm Dragon revives it.
allow.Cyber End Dragon: Malefic Cyber End Dragon banishes it from the Extra Deck to summon itself.
allow.Cosmic Blazar Dragon: Ultimate Synchro boss providing an all-encompassing Quick Effect negation.

main: Malefic Paradox Gear
Tributes itself to summon Parallel Gear and search a Malefic; stands in for any original a Malefic would banish.
Malefic Parallel Gear
Tuner that makes Malefic Paradox Dragon with a Malefic from the hand.
Malefic Stardust Dragon
Banishes Stardust Dragon to summon itself; protects your Field Spell.
Malefic Cyber End Dragon
Banishes Cyber End Dragon to summon itself: 4000 ATK.
Malefic Blue-Eyes White Dragon
Summons itself through Paradox Gear: 3000 ATK.
Malefic Red-Eyes Black Dragon
Summons itself through Paradox Gear: a Level 7 body.
Malefic Rainbow Dragon
Summons itself through Paradox Gear: 4000 ATK.
Malefic Paradigm Dragon
Banishes a Malefic from the Extra Deck; mills a Malefic to revive a banished Level 8 Synchro.
Malefic Truth Dragon
Pays half your LP to replace a fallen Malefic; wipes their monsters in battle.
Malefic World
The Field Spell everything needs; trades your draw for a Malefic card.
Malefic Territory
Places Malefic World from the Deck and lets you control several differently named Malefics.
Malefic Selector
Banishes two Malefic cards to search two more.
Malefic Divide
Quick-Play: revives a Malefic, ignoring its conditions.
Malefic Paradigm Shift
Newest support. Adds or places Malefic World, then summons a Malefic from the Deck or Extra Deck; can be activated from the hand.
Malefic Force
Newest support. Equip that searches a Malefic card; from the GY, wipes every monster with a Field Spell out.
Malefic Tune
Draws two when a Malefic falls; from the GY, searches one.
